summary: The support-lift maxima are attained because only finitely many hit subsets can occur. Edgewise domination proves C_beta <= U_beta <= R, and the strengthened ledger follows by applying the resulting bound on R together with the two other independent accepted capacity bounds. In the zero-fresh branch, C_beta = B_cong yields one affine map retaining every positively charged edge; the negative-circuit moment cancellations force that map to miss every circuit, every positive-load missed edge is lossless, and the hard-ledger estimates give the strict mass bound. The empty-support and zero-rank conventions are handled consistently. No mathematical error or gap was found.
